A batch of FD&C Yellow No. 6 may be certified for use in cosmetics if it conforms to the requirements of § 82.5 and to the specifications set forth in this subpart for such color [1]. The term "straight color" includes lakes and substances permitted by the specifications for such color [2].

21 CFR 70.3(j) defines "straight color" as a color additive listed in parts 73, 74, and 81 of this chapter, and includes lakes and such substances as are permitted by the specifications for such color [2].  

21 CFR 82.50 requires that a batch of a straight color listed in this subpart conform to the requirements of § 82.5 and to the specifications in this subpart set forth for such color in order to be certified for use in food, drugs, and cosmetics [1].
